record.title: Implicit degree bias in the link prediction task
record.reason: The paper diagnoses degree-sampling bias in general link-prediction benchmarks. Section 2.4 evaluates 95 graphs spanning social, technology, information, biology and transportation; Section 3 explains biokg_drug only as one rich-club counterexample. Biological graphs are secondary to a cross-domain benchmarking claim.

record.title: When, Where and Why to Average Weights?
record.reason: Weight averaging is evaluated as a generic training-efficiency technique across seven AlgoPerf workloads. Appendix A.1 includes FastMRI among Criteo, ImageNet, OGBG, WMT and two LibriSpeech models. The medical dataset is one cross-domain optimization workload, so it does not meet the primary-biomedical rule.
